_comment: Manufacturer figures for the BYD RACCO, typed in by hand from the
source named on each row. Nothing here is computed, inferred or
model-generated: see opitrics/analyze/specs.py for why.
EVERY SOURCE IS A PAGE, NEVER A FILE DOWNLOAD. These figures were
first taken from BYD's catalogue PDF, which meant every 'check' link
fired a 5.5 MB download instead of opening something a reader could
read. On a page whose whole argument is 'click it and see', that is
the wrong destination. The lineup page carries the same 主要諸元
table (hydrated client-side from embedded JSON, so it is in the HTML
even though it renders via JavaScript), and it is what a reader
should land on.
Four figures are therefore absent: ground clearance, DC charging
rate, V2H/V2L and the power sliding doors. All four are printed only
in the catalogue PDF, and a figure whose only source is a download
does not go on the page. Two of them had no comment themes anyway,
and DC charging shared its theme with range, so nothing is lost but
the rows themselves.
All three trim prices ARE on the lineup page under
メーカー希望小売価格(税込) — an earlier note here claimed the two
higher trims were only in trade coverage, which was wrong.
`aspect` joins a row to the taxonomy key whose themes discuss it, so
the weight figure lands beside the weight argument. Leave it empty
when nothing in the corpus raised the attribute — the row still
shows, with a dash in the comment column.

specs.label: Length × width × height
